svg.title: Application evidence: status of the review audit
svg.desc: The inherited evidence heat map is not retained as a verified assessment. The figure lists application areas requiring claim-level source checks.
svg.text: Application claims: evidence review still required
No ranking of maturity or validation strength is asserted in this revision.
For each application, verify before assigning an evidence level
1. Is the claim theoretical, numerical, experimentally measured, or independently replicated?
2. Are materials, parameters, boundary conditions, and uncertainty reported?
3. Is the application result checked against observations not used for calibration?
This is an audit checklist, not a substitute for reading the cited primary studies.
